description: Add a new website (a new AI agent) to the account and return its embed code. Each plan allows a limited number of websites, and this refuses once that limit is reached. By default it also starts a crawl of the site to build the knowledge base.

crawl.description: Crawl the site after adding it. True by default.

domain.description: The website address, for example shop.example.com.

name.description: Display name for this agent. Optional.

name: create_website
title: Add a website
